about: Revocation recorded but effective in the future: the record exists at the evaluation instant, its effect does not.
why: Evaluated at 2026-11-23T00:00:00Z. The status says revoked, the record's own effectiveFrom says the effect starts one day later. A checker that reads only `status` refuses here; the correct reading is that the gateway cannot decide on the strength of a record whose effect has not begun, so could-not-determine (hold) with a distinct code rather than a plain REVOKED. Paired control: D11 has a revocation effective in the past, which must still refuse.
